assets.finding: Light warm-neutral fine crystals are evenly distributed. In 2x2/4x4 and native opposing strips/corner junctions, no prominent straight seam band or darker perimeter was visible; single-pixel grain changes remain.

Restrained pale champagne mineral branches on white stone. Some fine branches terminate or change phase at the opposing edge; not every vein continues as one exact curve. At the inspected repeat/lighting scales these do not form a prominent dark line or square grid. Small-footprint mipmapping weakens the faint gold detail.

Warm ivory cloud-like mineral variation. The repeated diagonal cloud clusters are recognizable in 4x4; this low-frequency motif cycle remains. No prominent coarse straight border or color step was visible in the inspected opposing strips and repeat/GPU figures.
